gloss: fillet; slice of fish or meat

definitions.gloss: fillet; slice of fish or meat
definitions.explanation: A portion of fish or meat that has been cut into pieces suitable for cooking. Most commonly refers to fish fillets or steaks sold at supermarkets.

examples.english: Sprinkle salt on the fillet and grill it.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{身|み}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧になっていた。
examples.english: Fresh fish fillets were half price at the supermarket.

notes:
The standard word for pre-cut portions of fish (or sometimes meat) as sold in stores and used in cooking. Most commonly refers to fish — a typical supermarket fish counter sells fish as {切|き}り{身|み} rather than whole.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{身|み}: salmon fillet
- ⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{身|み}: mackerel fillet
- {切|き}り{身|み}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill a fillet
- {切|き}り{身|み}{魚|ざかな}: fish sold as fillets

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: sashimi — raw fish sliced thin for eating as-is, distinct from {切|き}り{身|み} which is for cooking
- ⟦{柵|さく}→柵：13103_saku⟧: a block of sashimi-grade fish before slicing
- ⟦{丸|まる}ごと→丸ごと：10545_marugoto⟧: whole (fish) — the opposite of {切|き}り{身|み}
